tool.title: Count the tangles in ArchiMate views: lines crossing lines, and lines through boxes
tool.description: For each view, as `render-view.ts` draws it, count the pairs of lines that cross and the lines that run through a box they do not connect (groups, and boxes that hold one of the line's ends, excepted). With `--view` it lists each tangle by the boxes it joins; with `--max` it is a gate.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The `.archimate` file (plain XML or Archi's zipped archive).

inputs.name: view
inputs.description: One view, by its Archi id (`id-<hex>`) or its page slug (e.g. `1-central-health-workforce-registry`). A slug, not free text, so no shell payload can ride on it. Absent: every view in the model.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Exit 1 if any view has more tangles than this.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: Print JSON instead of one line per view.

outputs.name: tangles
outputs.description: Per view: crossings and lines through a box.

selection.when: Before and after every change to an ArchiMate view, so a change never adds tangles (skill `archimate-models`, "Untangle every view you touch").
selection.limits: Counts the lines as drawn by this harness's renderer, which draws a stale Archi route straight; Archi itself may draw the same view slightly differently.
selection.cost: Milliseconds per view. No network, no JVM.
